title: Vertra wiring types (teams/<team>/types.yaml), format v2
description: The kinds of thing a team's products make or name, such as gcp.project: an input says it needs one (x-vertra-needs), an output that it is one (x-vertra-provides). The order builder and the console's chat agent wire carts by them, add a type's default provider when a cart needs one, and offer what the team already has of it. Each type is defined once in the catalog, by the team whose types.yaml names it.

name.description: Lower-case words joined by dots, such as gcp.project. Unique in the catalog.

description.description: What a value of it is, for people and for the chat agent: a Google Cloud project's id.

shared.description: True: one value for the whole order (a region), asked once when nothing in the order provides it, rather than a step added.

defaultProvider.description: <product>.<action>, one of this team's, whose output provides the type: what an order adds when it needs one and has none. Omit it where people usually have one already.
